lead_raw_text:
The structure of Mn₆Si₂ (reduced formula Mn₃Si) crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I-4m2 (No. 119), with eight atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies Mn centers in two environments: a tetrahedral motif with four Si neighbors and an octahedral motif with six Mn neighbors, while Si centers show eight Mn neighbors. The Mn tetrahedra and octahedra share corners and edges, and the Si-centered 8-vertex polyhedra share corners, edges, and faces with each other. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component containing all eight sites.
